title: 第5章 舞蹈学校的防空洞第6章 专业
slug: 废墟探险家第325章回魂芭
content_zh:
鲁斯兰的枪店距离这座集市仅仅只有一条街的距离，不等白芑在枪店门口把车子停稳，挂着暂停营业牌子的店门便被鲁斯兰从里面推开。
“你总算来了”
鲁斯兰根本不给白芑下车的机会，“等下跟着我，这就出发咱们。”
“这么急？”原本已经将一只脚都迈出去的白芑好奇的问道。
“当然急，我还约了我的朋友。”
鲁斯兰说着，已经拉开他那辆雪佛兰涅瓦的车门钻了进去。
“谁啊？”白芑的询问只换来了对方启动车子时的轰鸣。
压着内心的疑惑，两辆宛若玩具般的小车一前一后的跑了起来。
只不过，让他疑惑的是，鲁斯兰最后竟然将车子开到了莫大的门口。
这次依旧没等他拉起手刹，便有一辆虽然经过了重度澳洲式改装，但是却难免有些过时的陆巡80越野车开出来，朝着他们闪了闪车灯。
这又是谁啊？
白芑好奇的嘀咕了一句，最终还是习惯性的关了行车记录仪，踩下油门跟着前面那两辆车重新跑了起来。
一行三辆车离开城区之后，在鲁斯兰的带领下一路开往了东南方向。
昨天鲁斯兰嘴里提及的舞蹈学校所在的位置远比白芑预料的更远，远到车子都开到了莫斯科城南边缘的索帕克夫，这才停在了这座城市的东南边缘，一座紧挨着森林，看起来已经荒废了相当长时间的院子门口。
此时此刻，这荒草丛生的大门口还停着一辆4轮卡玛斯板车，其上驮着一辆小型履带式挖掘机和一个还没来得及换上的破拆锤。
这都不用问，肯定是鲁斯兰提前安排的，毕竟无论这辆卡车还是卡车上的挖掘机，都是他跟着对方在半年前买下的二手货。
在白芑的注视下，鲁斯兰拎着一把剪线钳推门下车，打开了锈迹斑斑的铁门，招呼着后面这两辆车开进了荒草丛生，而且似乎还有野兔生活的院子。
等鲁斯兰也将车子开进来的时候，白芑已经将车子停在了这个院子里唯一的一座四层建筑正门口。
停车熄火之后，白芑却并没有急着下车，反而耐心的等到另外两辆车停稳并且相继推开车门，这才熄火推开了车门。
近乎下意识的，他便把注意力放在了那辆老越野车里钻出来的人身上。

这人可真够壮的！
白芑看着对方不由的咋舌，这个男人的身高恐怕能有两米二往上，尤其夸张的是，他在钻出车厢之后，那辆车明显变高了一截。
他怎么钻进去的？斯拉夫天赋？
就在白芑暗暗好奇这个无关紧要的小问题的时候，这个壮汉已经绕到车尾，打开天地门拎出一个高尔夫球杆包甩在了肩上。
紧接着，他又绕到副驾驶一侧，伸手拉开了副驾驶的车门。
直到这个时候，一个黑褐色头发，穿着牛仔裤白大褂和高腰军靴，头上却不伦不类的搭了一顶遮阳帽和一副黄色射击眼镜，而且手上还戴着一副战术手套的高挑姑娘才从副驾驶迈步钻了出来。
白大褂？这是个大夫？战术小香风混搭大夫？这两位干嘛来的？COSPLA？
带着内心的疑惑收回目光，白芑迈步走了过去。
“让我来介绍一下”
鲁斯兰换上了俄语，“这就是我的好兄弟奥列格，他虽然是个华夏人，但是在探索苏联军事废墟这件事情上没有比他更专业的了。”
“你好，我是塔拉斯，塔拉斯·舍甫琴科。”
这名壮汉主动朝白芑伸出了手，“我和鲁斯兰是大学同学。”
“你也好”
身高一米八往上的白芑站在这个宛若一堵墙一般的壮汉面前简直像个小朋友，以至于他不得不仰着脖子和对方握手，“不要相信鲁斯兰的吹捧，我绝对算不上专业。”
content_en:
Ruslan's gun store was only one street away from the market. Before Bai Qi could park the car at the door of the gun store, Ruslan pushed open the store door with a temporary suspension sign from inside.
"You're finally here"
Ruslan didn't give Bai Qi a chance to get out of the car, "Follow me later, we'll leave now."
"In such a hurry?" Bai Qi, who had already put one foot out, asked curiously.
"Of course it's urgent. I also made an appointment with my friends."
Ruslan said, already opening the door of his Chevrolet Neva and getting in.
"Who is it?" Bai Zhi's inquiry was only met with a roar when the other party started the car.
Suppressing the doubts in his heart, the two toy-like cars started running one after another.
However, what puzzled him was that Ruslan finally drove the car to Moda's door.
This time, before he could pull up the handbrake, a Land Cruiser 80 off-road vehicle that had been heavily modified in Australian style but was inevitably somewhat outdated drove out and flashed its lights towards them.
Who is this?
Bai Qi murmured curiously, and finally turned off the driving recorder out of habit, stepped on the accelerator and started running again following the two cars in front.
After a group of three vehicles left the city, they drove all the way to the southeast under the leadership of Ruslan.
The location of the dance school mentioned by Ruslan yesterday was far further than Bai Qi expected. It was so far away that the car drove to Sopakov on the southern edge of Moscow, and then stopped at the southeastern edge of the city, at the entrance of a courtyard next to the forest that seemed to have been abandoned for a long time.
At this moment, a four-wheel KAMAZ truck was parked at the overgrown gate, carrying a small crawler excavator and a demolition hammer that had not yet had time to be replaced.
No need to ask, Ruslan must have arranged it in advance. After all, both the truck and the excavator on the truck were second-hand goods that he bought with the other party half a year ago.
Under Bai Zhi's gaze, Ruslan pushed the door open and got out of the car with a pair of wire cutters, opened the rusty iron door, and greeted the two cars behind to drive into the yard where there were weeds and there seemed to be hares living there.
By the time Ruslan also drove in, Bai Qi had already parked the car at the front entrance of the only four-story building in the yard.
After parking the car and turning off the engine, Bai Qi did not rush to get out of the car. Instead, she patiently waited until the other two cars came to a stop and opened the doors one after another before turning off the engine and pushing open the doors.
Almost subconsciously, he focused on the person getting out of the old off-road vehicle.
This man is really strong!
Bai Zhi looked at the other person and couldn't help but gasped. This man was probably over two meters tall. What was especially exaggerated was that after he got out of the car, the car became obviously taller.
How did he get in? Slavic talent?
Just when Bai Qi was secretly curious about this inconsequential issue, the strong man had already walked around to the back of the car, opened the door, took out a golf club bag and threw it on his shoulder.
Immediately afterwards, he walked around to the passenger side and reached out to open the passenger door.
It was only then that a tall girl with dark brown hair, wearing jeans, a white coat and high-waisted military boots, with a sun hat and a pair of yellow shooting glasses on her head, and a pair of tactical gloves on her hands stepped out from the passenger seat.
White coat? Is this a doctor? Tactical little fragrance mix and match doctor? Why are these two here? COSPLA?
With inner doubts, Bai Zhi looked away and walked over.
"Let me introduce you."
Ruslan switched to Russian and said, "This is my good brother Oleg. Although he is Chinese, there is no one more professional than him in exploring the Soviet military ruins."
"Hello, I'm Taras, Taras Shevchenko."
nameThe strong man took the initiative to reach out to Bai Zhi and said, "Ruslan and I are college classmates."
"You too"
Standing in front of this wall-like man, Bai Qi, who was 1.8 meters tall, looked like a child, so much so that he had to tilt his neck to shake hands with him, "Don't believe Ruslan's flattery, I'm definitely not a professional."
